frame_declarations.scope: Declared fixed frame objects with single DW_OP_fbreg locations. Standard frame-pointer prologues are required before spill geometry uses CFA=EBP+8. Indexed frame accesses are restricted to declared object extents; invalid bounds/arbitrary stack inspection are not covered.

review.scope: Local card-data address bias only, under existing callee/global correspondences and GCC i386 ABI rules. A CFG worklist tracks modulo-32-bit differences in registers and compiler-private frame words. Every affected memory access must cancel the actual displacement change, with unchanged width. Pointer values cannot escape into arguments/comparisons or partial writes. Address-taken frame objects must be disjoint from biased spill slots; indexed frame accesses must remain within the pinned DWARF object extents. Invalid bounds, arbitrary memory aliases and stack inspection are outside this source-level review. Only four named, cross-CU public C helpers discharge caller-saved pointer temporaries; other calls require equal volatile registers. This is not whole-handler or gameplay equivalence, and does not certify other mapped code/data identities. Unsupported mixed changes remain unresolved; no source edits or score changes.
